rows = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def crop(r0,r1,c0,c1): return [rows[r][c0:c1] for r in range(r0,r1)]
def normraw(sh):
    rs=[r for r in range(7) if any(ch not in 'SP' for ch in sh[r])]
    cs=[c for c in range(7) if any(row[c] not in 'SP' for row in sh)]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    return ''.join(''.join('B' if sh[r][c] not in 'SP' else '.' for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
start = normraw(crop(51,58,14,21))
print("start:", start)
seen = [start]
for i in range(12):
    action(['UP'])
    rows = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    g = normraw(crop(51,58,14,21))
    seen.append(g)
    print(i+1, g, "BACK" if g==start else "")
    if g==start: break
